subject: design/e2e-verification-artifacts-v2
statement: The e2e design doc remains a **lightweight authored document class** with its own per-feature home, frozen at operator approval, off the generated design index — and its version bumps to **`e2e-design/v2`**, whose harness section is a **closed slot form**: one slot per mechanical element the basis enumerates plus one conditional decision-authority stand-in slot, or, where a fitting harness already exists, an alternate form citing it and listing only this feature's delta. Each scenario additionally carries its run facts and its build facts in **two scenario-keyed tables** cross-checked to the same scenario set, one of which names the single artifact that scenario exclusively owns. **Presence is mechanical and substance is judgment**: a checker rejects an empty, placeholder, or bare-library-name slot and a table set that disagrees, while the review's buildability lens judges whether what is written could actually be built from (`design-brainstorm:e2e-verification-tech-design-2#D-3`, `#D-5`, `#D-6`, `#D-7`).
